scope: D-INT-01 / P0-P1 Native RapidFlow Integration Architecture Validation

cases.name: Build, Link, and Runtime Provenance Verification
cases.description: Genuinely compile and link RapidFlow Graph C++ source; verify runtime accessors and record binary SHA-256 and compiler flags
cases.expected_behavior: Graph accessors execute successfully and binary SHA-256 matches build output

cases.name: Graph and Typed Boundary Codec Verification
cases.description: Verify external-to-internal dense ID bijection and typed label distinction (int 0 != str '0') on RapidFlow Graph
cases.expected_behavior: Codec round-trips sparse, negative, and large IDs cleanly; preserves int 0 vs str '0' distinction without collision

cases.name: Mutable GlobalEdgeView Behavior Verification
cases.description: Audit insertion, removal, sorted order, duplicate/absent return values, and container label absence in GlobalEdgeView
cases.expected_behavior: Maintains sorted vectors; duplicate insertion returns false; absent deletion returns false; container does not store edge labels

cases.name: Diamond Counterexample: Exact NLF Prunes Valid APX Matches
cases.description: Demonstrate on Diamond (k=1, lambda=2) that RapidFlow exact NLF prunes valid APX embedding (0,1,2,3), proving NLF filter cannot be used as-is
cases.expected_behavior: M0 accepts identity match; RapidFlow exact nlf_check returns false and candidate filter prunes valid vertices; raw view retains edges

cases.name: Snapshot Ordering and Transactional Rollback
cases.description: Verify INSERT sees G_after, DELETE sees G_before, and mid-stream fault injection triggers clean atomic rollback
cases.expected_behavior: Snapshot timing matches CSM specification; injected fault in Step 3 cleanly reverts Step 3 while preserving Step 1-2 commits

cases.name: Count vs Tuple Boundary Audit on K4
cases.description: Analyze RapidFlow COUNT-ONLY execution on K4 (scalar 24 via leaf shortcut and automorphism factorization) vs 24 explicit M0 tuples; specify P2 tuple path
cases.expected_behavior: RapidFlow native reports COUNT_ONLY scalar 24; does not materialize embeddings; P2 tuple path design documented
